David Vance
Principal Backend Software Architect
Chicago, IL | david.vance@archmail.com | +1 312-555-0149 | linkedin.com/in/davidvance-architect | github.com/davidvance-core

PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY
Distinguished Principal Backend Architect with 11+ years of experience engineering high-throughput, low-latency distributed systems using Java, Spring Boot, Apache Kafka, and PostgreSQL. Proven track record in designing resilient event-driven architectures processing 50,000+ transactions per second (TPS). Expert in domain-driven design (DDD), microservices decompilation, database sharding, and cloud scalability.

WORK EXPERIENCE
Principal Backend Architect | Apex Financial Technologies | Chicago, IL | 2020 - Present
- Architected enterprise core banking transaction processing engine in Java 21, Spring Boot, and Kafka, handling 50,000+ TPS with sub-20ms p99 latency.
- Led distributed systems re-architecture across 30+ development teams, decoupling legacy core into 65 scalable microservices on AWS EKS.
- Designed distributed multi-region data replication strategy with PostgreSQL sharding and Redis caching, cutting database load by 58%.
- Established technical governance, architectural review board (ARB), and coding standards for 140+ engineers across 4 global hubs.
- Reduced infrastructure cloud hosting costs by $650K per year through container optimization, JVM memory tuning, and connection pooling.

Lead Backend Engineer | FinScale Systems | New York, NY | 2016 - 2020
- Engineered real-time fraud detection pipeline using Java, Apache Flink, and Kafka Streams, intercepting $18M+ in fraudulent charges annually.
- Built high-reliability gRPC and RESTful internal communication APIs with resilience patterns including circuit breakers (Resilience4j) and rate limiting.
- Migrated 4TB database cluster from Oracle to Amazon Aurora PostgreSQL with zero data loss and under 10 minutes of planned maintenance.
- Led 12 senior engineers, conducted technical interviews, and hired 25+ software developers.

EDUCATION
Master of Science in Computer Science | University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign | 2014 - 2016
Bachelor of Science in Computer Science | Purdue University | 2010 - 2014

TECHNICAL SKILLS
- Languages & Runtimes: Java (8/11/17/21), Kotlin, SQL, Python, Go
- Frameworks & Middleware: Spring Boot, Spring Cloud, Quarkus, Hibernate, Apache Kafka, Kafka Streams, RabbitMQ, gRPC
- Databases & Storage: PostgreSQL, MySQL, Redis, DynamoDB, MongoDB, Elasticsearch, Liquibase
- Distributed Systems & Architecture: Domain-Driven Design (DDD), Event-Driven Architecture, Microservices, CQRS, Sharding, Multi-Tenancy
- Cloud & Infrastructure: AWS, Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform, Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry, Git

CERTIFICATIONS
- Oracle Certified Master: Java SE Enterprise Architect (2021)
- Confluent Certified Developer for Apache Kafka (CCDAK) (2022)
- AWS Certified Solutions Architect - Professional (2023)
jobDescriptionText:
We are seeking a Principal Backend Architect to lead our distributed platform engineering. Requirements:
- 10+ years backend engineering experience with Java and Spring Boot.
- Deep expertise in Apache Kafka, event-driven architectures, and high-throughput systems.
- Proven experience designing PostgreSQL/distributed database architectures and microservices.
- Strong leadership in architectural governance, mentoring engineering teams, and cloud scalability on AWS.
